candidate.title: Failed host.save leaves rejected buffered edits applied locally (no rollback on save error)
reports: [bug] host.save(props) applies the buffered values to the underlying record before the request, and the .catch only pops an alert without rolling the record back, so after a failed save (e.g. a 422 for an invalid host format) clicking cancel runs rollbackbuffer() against the already-mutated record and the row then displays the rejected values as though they persisted. an admin whose save is rejected sees the row render the unsaved host/category after clicking cancel, with no error and no indication that the server still holds the old values until a page reload reverts them.
